Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Foreigners Tribunal Sribhumi Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator post is scheduled for 09 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for the Data Entry Operator post. Age relaxation is applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Data Entry Operator position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 10,000/-.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the HS examination from a recognized Board/Council and possess a minimum 6-month computer Diploma Certificate from a Government-recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Data Entry Operator post announced by Foreigners Tribunal Sribhumi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Foreigners Tribunal Sribhumi office. Specific venue details should be confirmed from the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested copies of their ID proof, educational certificates, computer diploma certificate, and category certificate (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The Data Entry Operator position is on a contractual basis.
